blocks.text: Unwind with a bigger screen Enjoy more downtime on a large 13.1" screen,¹whether you’re shopping online, unwinding with cat videos or playing your favorite word game. Plus, dual speakers make everything sound amazing. Circle anything. Search everything. Simply circle to search for virtually anything you can see on your Galaxy Tab S10 FE+. From discovering where to buy those awesome shoes to getting a recipe for that dish your friend just posted, find answers using Circle to Search with Google. Water resistant, from drops to dunks From droplets to splashes to full immersion in water, you can feel secure taking your Galaxy Tab S10 FE+ with you. It’s one of the only water-and dust-resistant tablets. Pen-point precision Write up to-do lists by hand, or enjoy drawing during your free time. S Pen features a responsive design that feels like you’re writing on actual paper so nothing gets in your way when your imagination is flowing. Great battery. Fast charging. Stay ready to indulge in your downtime. Finish your favorite series or book with a battery that can last up to 21 hours. Front and rear cameras for clear video calls Stay connected with a great camera on Galaxy Tab S10 FE+ that makes video calls clearer and more engaging. Whether you’re catching up with friends or showing off your latest creation, you’ll always look your best. Plus, with a large display, you can see every expression and detail, making conversations feel more natural and immersive. Easy home management at a glance Conveniently manage your home from anywhere using SmartThings home management on your Galaxy Tab S10 FE+. With Map View, you can see your entire home and every connected device at a glance, enabling easy control and automation of each room with just a tap. Add as a widget for even faster access to your home controls right from your home screen.
